scope_revision.authorization: supervisor joint-rethink ruling after F1 method-class disposition
scope_revision.timing: before any F2 execution or scoring
scope_revision.reason: the only available dual-lane corpus is not human-audited and therefore cannot support acceptance claims
scope_revision.supersedes: the unexecuted development/validation selection and gated-gain protocol in schema v1

runtime_input.unknown_lane_behavior: neutral multiplier 1.0; never infer a lane from evaluation truth

algorithm.input: runtime-visible production EndpointPolicy units, production WeSpeaker vectors, and capture-lane provenance
algorithm.lane_centroids: leave-one-unit-out duration-weighted centroid for each known capture lane
algorithm.soft_prior: multiply a cross-known-lane centroid similarity by 1-prior-strength; same-lane or either-unknown similarity is unchanged
algorithm.assignment_probe: compare each unit's own-lane and other-lane centroid scores before and after the soft prior
algorithm.reason_no_identity_claim: the corpus has no human-audited speaker or activity truth and a lane is not assumed to contain one person

exploratory_grid.selection: none; report every preregistered strength without choosing or freezing a winner

exploratory_dual_lane.permitted_measurement: runtime-frame acoustic lane-prior effect size only

preconditions_before_measurement.full_chain_audit: audio and runtime lane metadata to candidate decision boundary; no reference or scorer input is reachable
preconditions_before_measurement.label_perturbation: change synthetic evaluation labels A,B to A,A; runtime unit shape and complete candidate-decision semantic hash must remain identical

reported_effect_sizes: duration-weighted mean, median, and p95 own-lane-minus-other-lane cosine margin before and after prior
duration-weighted count and duration of lane-consistency classification flips
duration-weighted own-lane classification rate before and after prior
cross-lane score reduction by prior strength

acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.corpus: multiple meetings with both local-mic and remote-system lanes, varied speakers, genders, acoustics, crosstalk, overlap, and genuine same-speaker-across-lanes cases
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.source_integrity: immutable synchronized audio and runtime lane metadata with captured missing-lane and wrong-lane controls
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.human_audit: speaker and activity references audited for identity, timing, overlap, and crosstalk; no one-person-per-lane assumption
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.splits: preregistered development, validation, and single-open blind holdout containing long meetings and similar-voice hard cases
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.instrument: D8-safe production runtime segmentation, full-chain golden-path audit, label-perturbation invariance, and same-frame L1/F2 comparison
acceptance_grade_evidence_requirements.acceptance_metrics: duration-weighted speaker accuracy, DER family, FP speaker-seconds, per-case regressions, two-sided mapping, determinism, and compute budget under the campaign gates
